entries: I am afraid not, for we also seek the owner of the book... if there is anything left to find.
恐怕没有。因为我们也寻找书的主人……如果还剩下什么可找的话。
Many attempted to get to the Shelter with us, but few made it.
许多人曾和我们一起试着来到庇护所，但成功的人寥寥无几。
Once here, the power in this place protects the mind from degrading further. I suspect the book has a similar effect.
来到这里之后，此地的力量保护心智不至于继续崩坏。我猜想，那本书也有类似的效果。
You can read!? And you have the book? The Codex? No wonder you were able to find us.
你识字！？而且你拿着那本书？典籍？难怪你能找到我们。
A shelter from what? Why would such a place exist below ground?
躲避什么的地方？为什么会有这样的地方建在地下？
That is the calamity. The slow loss of all knowledge and memory. I was hoping that you had escaped.
那就是灾变。一切知识与记忆缓慢的流失。我原以为你逃过了一劫。
How did you make it here, with little to no memory?
几乎没有记忆，你是怎么来到这里的？
I do not care, so long as there is something to eat other than rat.
我不在乎，只要除了老鼠还有别的可吃。
Then, perhaps you are the one who sent me to retrieve the book.
那么，也许就是您派我去取那本书的。
What calamity are you referring to? I am afraid we cannot remember very much.
您说的是什么灾变？恐怕我们记不得多少了。
Please, come in. We will be happy to answer more of your questions once you are settled.
请进。等你们安顿下来，我们很乐意再回答你们更多问题。
I was beginning to think I would not live to see this day.
我差点以为，自己活不到这一天了。
欢迎来到卡林德劳尔——我们的庇护所。
Forgive me. My name is Quay. And this is Naira.
恕我失礼。我叫奎伊。这位是奈拉。
It seems to have begun when I happened upon this old book. I can only read some of it.
一切似乎始于我偶然得到这本旧书的时候。我只能读懂其中一部分。
Pleased to meet you. We have been hiding here for... years perhaps. Ever since the calamity befell our world.
幸会。我们躲在这里已经……也许好几年了。自灾变降临我们的世界以来。
Can it be? Has someone come at last?
